mapper.select: SELECT 'YARN_SPEC' AS biz_type, id AS biz_id, spec_name AS display_name, updater AS deleted_by, update_time AS deleted_time FROM lunaerp_production_yarn_spec WHERE deleted = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_yarn_requisition_item WHERE yarn_spec_id = #{yarnSpecId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_yarn_order_item WHERE yarn_spec_id = #{yarnSpecId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_yarn_recipe_bom_item WHERE yarn_spec_id = #{yarnSpecId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_sample_analysis_yarn_spec WHERE yarn_spec_id = #{yarnSpecId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_stock_in_item WHERE yarn_spec_id = #{yarnSpecId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) )
